# IndieWire

> > Leading source for film and entertainment news, covering independent cinema, major studios like Warner Bros., film festivals including Sundance and Berlin, and industry analysis.

IndieWire, part of Penske Media Corporation, provides comprehensive coverage of the entertainment industry with a focus on independent film, awards season, film criticism, industry business news, and festival coverage. The site features reviews, trailers, craft features, and analysis of major industry developments from filmmakers and studios worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Independent Film & Distribution
- Sundance Film Festival
- Film Reviews & Criticism
- Warner Bros. & Major Studios
- Awards Season Coverage
- Film Financing & Business
- International Cinema
- Documentary Filmmaking
- Festival Coverage (Berlin, Beyond Fest)
- Industry Analysis & Mergers
- Directorial Debuts
- Western & Genre Cinema
- Production Design & Craft
- Streaming & Distribution Platforms

- [How to Raise $10 Million: Software Changing Independent Film Financing](https://www.indiewire.com/news/analysis/how-to-build-10-million-film-fund-from-your-basement-1235173899): How Craftsman Films uses software platforms for indie film financing
- [Legion M Film Fund Lets You Invest in a Movie's Distribution](https://www.indiewire.com/news/business/legion-m-film-fund-distribution-1235173921): Legion M launches crowdfunding film fund for distribution investment
- [2026 Sundance Sales Market Analysis: Warner Bros Leads New Buyers](https://www.indiewire.com/features/general/sundance-2026-sales-market-analysis-warner-bros-1235173142): Analysis of Warner Bros and new distributors at Sundance 2026 sales market
